entries.title: Lamentations 5:1
segments: ¶Remember, O Jehovah, what is come upon us; consider, and see our reproach.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:2
segments: Our inheritance is turned to strangers, our houses to aliens.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:3
segments: We are orphans and fatherless, our mothers are as widows.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:4
segments: Our water have we to drink for money, our wood cometh unto us for a price.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:5
segments: Our pursuers are on our necks: we are weary, we have no rest.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:6
segments: We have given the hand to Egypt, [and] to Asshur, to be satisfied with bread.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:7
segments: Our fathers have sinned, [and] they are not; and we bear their iniquities.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:8
segments: Bondmen rule over us: there is no deliverer out of their hand.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:9
segments: We have to get our bread at the risk of our lives, because of the sword of the wilderness.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:10
segments: Our skin gloweth like an oven, because of the burning heat of the famine.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:11
segments: They have ravished the women in Zion, the maids in the cities of Judah.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:12
segments: Princes were hanged up by their hand; the faces of elders were not honoured.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:13
segments: The young men have borne the mill, and the youths have stumbled under the wood.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:14
segments: The elders have ceased from the gate, the young men from their music.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:15
segments: The joy of our heart hath ceased; our dance is turned into mourning.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:16
segments: The crown is fallen from our head: woe unto us, for we have sinned!

entries.title: Lamentations 5:17
segments: ¶For this our heart is faint; for these things our eyes have grown dim,

entries.title: Lamentations 5:18
segments: Because of the mountain of Zion, which is desolate: foxes walk over it.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:19
segments: Thou, Jehovah, dwellest for ever; thy throne is from generation to generation.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:20
segments: Wherefore dost thou forget us for ever, dost thou forsake us so long time?

entries.title: Lamentations 5:21
segments: Turn thou us unto thee, Jehovah, and we shall be turned; renew our days as of old.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:22
segments: Or is it that thou hast utterly rejected us? Wouldest thou be exceeding wroth against us?
